none: PAS NLM-7DA504: Roman Coin: Copy Nummus of House of Constantine from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with probably two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this tiny coin. Diameter: 12.8mm, Weight: 1.23gms, die axis: 12
